title: Set up your society
lead: Add the buildings, floors and flats of {{name}}. Your progress is saved as you go.
loadError: We couldn't load your society's setup. Check your connection and try again.
draftSaved: Draft saved. You can come back to it any time.

details.title: Society details
details.lead: Parisar entered these when your society was registered. Check that they are right.
details.name: Society name
details.changeNote: To correct any of these details, contact Parisar. They can't be changed from this screen.
details.unavailable: You can still continue. The details will show here when they load.

wings.title: Add your wings
wings.lead: A wing is a building or block, such as A Wing or Tower 1. Add as many as you need.
wings.name: Wing name
wings.codeHint: Short code such as A or T1. Letters, numbers and hyphens, up to 10.
wings.floorsHint: You can rename floors and change flat counts in the next step.
wings.ground: Count the ground floor (it becomes floor 0)
wings.deleteBody: Its floors and flats are deleted too. A wing that residents or complaints already use can't be deleted.

errors.nameLong: Keep the wing name to 40 characters.
errors.nameDuplicate: There is already a wing with this name.
errors.codeInvalid: Use letters, numbers and hyphens only, up to 10.
errors.codeDuplicate: Another wing already uses this code.
errors.needOne: Add at least one wing to continue.

floors.lead: Check each wing's floors. Floor 0 is the ground floor; negative numbers are basements.
floors.name: Floor name
floors.noneYet: No floors yet. Add the first one.
floors.noWings: Floors and flats belong to a wing. Go back and add at least one wing.

errors.numberDuplicate: This wing already has this floor number.
errors.nameLong: Keep the floor name to 40 characters.
errors.needOne: Add at least one floor to continue.

flats.generatorLead: Give each floor a range of flat numbers. Numbers a wing already has are skipped.
flats.planSummary: Ready to create: {{total}} · Already exist and will be skipped: {{skipped}}
flats.generated: Flats created: {{created}}. Skipped because they already exist: {{skipped}}.
flats.allExist: All of these flat numbers already exist.
flats.noFloors: This wing has no floors yet.
flats.floorEmpty: No flats on this floor yet.
flats.areaHint: Carpet or built-up area, as you record it.
flats.parkingHint: A label only, such as P-12.
flats.deleteBody: A flat that residents, complaints or bookings already use can't be deleted.

errors.numberLong: Keep the flat number to 20 characters.
errors.numberExists: This wing already has a flat with this number.
errors.parkingLong: Keep the parking slot to 40 characters.
errors.rangeInvalid: A floor's range ends before it starts. Check the From and To numbers.
errors.noneToCreate: Enter a From and To number for at least one floor.
errors.needOne: Create at least one flat to continue.

optional.amenitiesLead: Add the amenities residents can see and book, such as a clubhouse or gym. You can skip this.
optional.laterLead: These have their own screens. Finish setup now and come back to them whenever you like.

authorities.title: Society authorities
authorities.body: Add other people who manage the society with you.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Record security, cleaners, plumbers and other staff.

guards.title: Gate guards
guards.body: Add the guards who log visitors at the gate.

residents_import.title: Import residents
residents_import.body: Upload an Excel sheet of residents to invite them faster.

done.title: Society setup
done.saved: Your wings, floors and flats are saved. Residents can now choose their flat when they join.
done.already: This society is already set up. You can review the structure or carry on.

personal.title: Do you live in this society?
personal.lead: Choose your own flat to join as a resident, or tell us you only manage the society.
personal.liveBody: Pick your flat and join as a resident, like everyone else.
personal.manageBody: You keep full access to the Society Dashboard without a flat.

metrics.title: At a glance
metrics.loadError: We couldn't load the society's numbers.
metrics.managerOnly: Only the society's chairman, secretary and treasurer can see these numbers.
metrics.setupBody: Residents can only pick their flat once wings, floors and flats are added.

import.title: Import residents
import.lead: Add many residents at once from an Excel sheet. Nothing is sent to them: each resident confirms their details when they sign in with their mobile number.
import.templateLead: Use the Parisar template: one row per resident, up to {{max}} rows.
import.templateFailed: The template couldn't be created. Try again.
import.fileHint: An .xlsx file up to {{size}} with at most {{max}} rows.
import.fileRequired: Choose the Excel file to check.
import.hasErrors: Rows with errors: {{count}}. They won't be imported. Fix them in the sheet and upload it again, or import the rest now.
import.nothingValid: No row can be imported yet. Fix the errors and upload the file again.
import.reportFailed: The error report couldn't be created. Try again.
import.cancelBody: The rows from this file are deleted from Parisar. No resident is added.
import.cancelled: Import cancelled. The rows from the file were deleted.
import.importedBody: Each one waits as pending until that resident signs in with the mobile number and confirms. Nothing was sent to them automatically.
import.newlyInvalid: Rows that changed since the check and were not imported: {{count}}.

instructions.1: Fill one row per resident on the Residents sheet. Keep the header row as it is.
instructions.2: Society Code, Wing, Floor, Flat, Full Name, Resident Type and Mobile are required. Email is optional.
instructions.3: Wing is the wing name or code. Floor is the floor number or name. Flat must already exist in Parisar.
instructions.4: Resident Type is Owner, Tenant or Family Member. Mobile is a 10-digit Indian number.
instructions.5: Nothing is sent to residents. Each resident confirms their details when they sign in.

parse.unreadable: This file couldn't be read. Save it as an Excel workbook (.xlsx) and try again.
parse.noSheet: This workbook has no sheet to read.
parse.missingColumns: These columns are missing: {{columns}}. Start from the Parisar template.
parse.noRows: The sheet has no resident rows yet.
parse.tooManyRows: The sheet has more than {{max}} rows. Split it into smaller files.

authLogin.title: Society authority sign-in
authLogin.lead: Enter your Authority Number: the mobile number Parisar registered for your society. We'll send it a one-time code.
authLogin.pickSub: Your number is an authority for more than one society. Which one do you want to open?
authLogin.notAuthoritySub: This number isn't on any society's authority list. You are signed in, so you can carry on as a resident.
authLogin.setPinSub: Set a 4-digit PIN for quicker sign-in next time. Then we'll take you to your society.

errors.generic: We couldn't open this society. Try again.
errors.NO_PHONE: Your account has no verified mobile number. Sign in again with your mobile.
errors.NOT_AN_AUTHORITY: Your number isn't on this society's authority list.
errors.SOCIETY_BLOCKED: Parisar has blocked this society. Contact Parisar for help.
